title: Microsoft reports Q1 Xbox hardware revenue down 14% YoY, Xbox content and services revenue down 2%, and Windows OEM and Devices revenue down 22% (Tom Warren/The Verge)
summary: Tom Warren / The Verge: Microsoft reports Q1 Xbox hardware revenue down 14% YoY, Xbox content and services revenue down 2%, and Windows OEM and Devices revenue down 22% — Windows and Xbox revenues have declined during Microsoft's first quarter of the 2027 financial year. … Microsoft just posted the first quarter of its 2027 fiscal financial results.
